entities.summary: Victor Vlad Cornea is a Romanian tennis player who specializes in doubles. He reached his highest ATP doubles ranking of No. 64 on 19 February 2024. He has won 15 ATP Challenger Tour doubles titles. Victor Vlad Cornea was a athletes & competitors from Sibiu (b. 1993-09-24, Sibiu). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
